english.title: Drive a motor vehicle on a road with eyesight which did not comply with requirements
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst your eyesight was such that you could not comply with a requirement as to eyesight prescribed under Part III of the Road Traffic Act 1988 for the purposes of tests of competence to drive, namely ability to read in good daylight a registration mark fixed to a motor vehicle and containing letters and figures 79 millimetres high and 50 millimetres wide at a distance of

(A)_[20 metres]_
(B)_[12 metres]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Option B relates to class K vehicles (mowing machines and pedestrian controlled vehicles).
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) On 08/03/13 the eyesight test requirements changed from 'letters and figures 79.4 millimetres high at a distance of 20.5 metres (or 12.3 metres)' to its current wording.
